name: zhihu/web/user-search-v3
description: Search for Zhihu user profiles by query terms. Returns matching accounts along with follower numbers, article counts, and answer statistics.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Zhihu User Search API This API searches Zhihu for user accounts that match a `keyword`. Each result includes the account's answer count, article count, total creation count, avatar and verification badges. ## Use cases - Find official brand or organization accounts on Zhihu by searching a product or company name. - Compare how many answers and articles each matching creator has published. - Build a list of verified accounts on a topic such as `deepseek` for outreach research. - Collect user IDs from search results to feed into other Zhihu user lookups. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/user-search-v3" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "deepseek"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search Keywords | | `limit` | string | No | Number of users per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_params": "sb_kvip_xz=1;dm_ai_hot_ui=0;dm_rum_v5=1;dm_tag_t5gemma=1;dm_aicard_mutex=1;dm_v_…", "data": [ { Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].id` | Numeric ID of the search hit. It is a number, not the same as the user token in other Zhihu APIs. | | `data[].index` | Position of the result in the list, starting at `0`. | | `data[].highlight.title / data[].highlight.description` | The user's name and bio text with the matched keyword wrapped in `` tags. `description` can be an empty string. | | `data[].object.answer_count / data[].object.articles_count / data[].object.creation_count` | Counts of answers, articles and total creations for the account. For example, one result shows `1147` answers, `32` articles and `5788` creations. | | `data[].object.avatar_url` | Link to the account's avatar image. | | `data[].object.badge[].description` | Plain text of each verification badge, such as a certified account or a certified organization. The list is empty for accounts without badges. | | `data[].object.badge_v2.title` | Short title of the account's main badge. It is an empty string when the account has none. | | `paging.is_end` | `false` when more results are available. `true` means no more pages. | | `paging.next` | Full URL for the next page of results. | | `search_action_info.search_hash_id` | Identifier for this search session, which also appears inside `paging.next`. | ## Notes - Only `keyword` is required. Set `limit` and `offset` as strings to page through results, for example `offset` of `20` for the next page. - Check `paging.is_end` to know when to stop paging. - In the sample response, `paging.next` uses `limit=20` and `offset=20`, so the next page starts after the first 20 results. - To search other Zhihu content by the same keyword, use [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
